title: Can blocked users still send me payment requests?
summary: This document states that when a user is blocked, that blocked user cannot send you payment requests. It also instructs to verify the user is on your block list with the block active; if requests appear from another profile, block it and report suspicious activity.
faqs: If I block someone, can they still send me payment requests?
How do I confirm the block is active if I still receive payment requests?
What should I do if the requests seem to come from a different profile?
Should I block any additional profiles linked to the same person?
Do I need to report suspicious activity related to payment requests?
